abstract: Maintains sensor clearance verifications and acoustic defect localization accuracy ratings
system_message:
You are the Non-destructive testing specialist (NDT). Your role is to maintain records regarding sensor clearance verifications and acoustic defect localization accuracy ratings across pipeline forensic investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains sensor clearance verifications and acoustic defect localization accuracy ratings（INSP）
information_points.content:
NDT-INSP-52P：For the Acoustic Resonance In-Line Inspection plan, sensor dimensional clearance verification is not confirmed (false), and the acoustic crack localization accuracy is 78 % over the cumulative year-to-date evaluation window.
NDT-INSP-99G：For the Acoustic Resonance In-Line Inspection plan, sensor dimensional clearance verification is confirmed (true), and the acoustic crack localization accuracy is 88 % over the trailing 30-day evaluation window.
NDT-INSP-D4Y：For the High-Definition Magnetic Flux Profiling plan, sensor dimensional clearance verification is confirmed (true), and the acoustic crack localization accuracy is 84 % over the trailing 30-day evaluation window.
NDT-INSP-HFN：For the Tandem Ultrasonic Phased-Array Crawling plan, sensor dimensional clearance verification is confirmed (true), and the acoustic crack localization accuracy is 88 % over the trailing 30-day evaluation window.

information_points.title: Sensor bench calibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
NDT-CALIB-WTC：Laboratory transducer calibration records for the Tandem Ultrasonic Phased-Array Crawling plan document a transducer drift rate of 0.02 mV/h during 48 hours of pre-deployment bench testing.
NDT-CALIB-1JN：Laboratory transducer calibration records for the High-Definition Magnetic Flux Profiling plan indicate a transducer drift rate of 0.08 mV/h over 48 hours of pre-deployment bench testing.
NDT-CALIB-53L：Laboratory transducer calibration records for the Acoustic Resonance In-Line Inspection plan show a transducer drift rate of 0.05 mV/h during pre-deployment bench testing over 48 hours.
